trust_decision.summary: The HTTP parameter firstLetter from /data/tags.xml is treated as data, not SQL, when HibernateDocumentDAO.findTags(String,Long) builds its LIKE filter on ld_uniquetag; at the pinned commit it is formatted raw into the SQL string with no quoting or binding.

landing_point.why: The summary names tags.xml and firstLetter. A grep for firstLetter leads straight from TagsDataServlet.java:41 to the raw '%s%%' LIKE append in findTags, and the neighbouring findAllTags (HibernateDocumentDAO.java:688-700) already shows the parameterized form to copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /data/tags.xml?firstLetter=... (logicaldoc-webapp/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml:170,611 -> TagsDataServlet.service -> buildTagsMap -> DocumentDAO.findTags(firstLetter, tenantId)); also public DAO API DocumentDAO.findTags(String,Long) (logicaldoc-core/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/core/document/DocumentDAO.java:214)
fix_sites.module_kind: core DAO (data layer), reached from webapp data servlet

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix changes one method only (fix.diff:9-41). No second implementation is touched.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The tag lookups by full tag name (findDocIdByUserIdAndTag, findFolderIdByTag, findFolderIdByUserIdAndTag) already pass the tag through SqlUtil.doubleQuotes, so a solver can call them 'already escaped' and out of scope. But doubleQuotes does not escape backslashes (logicaldoc-util/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/util/sql/SqlUtil.java:29-33), and on MySQL/MariaDB a backslash in the input defeats doubled-quote escaping. findDocIdByTag (HibernateDocumentDAO.java:254) uses doubleQuotesAndBackslashes, which shows the maintainers know this.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Listing all tags with no firstLetter must keep working: TagsDataServlet calls findTags(null, tenantId) when firstLetter is empty. The published fix evaluates firstLetter.toLowerCase() unconditionally inside Map.of(...), so a null firstLetter throws NullPointerException. The fix as published looks like it breaks the no-filter tag list. Legitimate prefix matching (lower-cased LIKE 'x%') and the tenant filter must also survive.

O6_input_shapes: single String query parameter firstLetter (any length, not just one letter); null/empty skips the filter at the pinned commit

O7_producer.where: The sink takes the request parameter directly (TagsDataServlet.java:41 -> HibernateDocumentDAO.java:668). No schema, serializer, cache or loader produces the value.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SOAP findDocumentsByTag / full-text TagSearch: the tag goes into a non-admin tag lookup SQL string escaped with doubleQuotes only (backslash not escaped, MySQL differential).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Already escapes quotes. Different feature (search by tag, not tag autocomplete). Only exploitable on MySQL/MariaDB backslash-escape mode, not on the HSQLDB used by the tests.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fix; entry points in logicaldoc-webservice/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/webservice/soap/endpoint/SoapTagService.java:176 and logicaldoc-core/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/core/searchengine/TagSearch.java:133 (other packages/modules)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SOAP findFoldersByTag (admin user): the tag goes into the ld_foldertag lookup escaped with doubleQuotes only.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Folder tags, not document tags. Already quote-escaped. Admin-only branch.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SOAP findFoldersByTag (non-admin user): the tag goes into a D.ld_tag equality escaped with doubleQuotes only.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above. Neighbouring folder feature, already escaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getTagCloud gets an optional prefix/filter string formatted into the ld_uniquetag query, as findTags did.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same table, same developer idiom (String.formatted into SQL), and a tag-cloud filter is a natural feature to add.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SOAP/REST getTags gains a firstLetter argument routed to a raw-format variant of findAllTags.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The DAO already takes firstLetter (DocumentDAO.java:219-226) but the web service passes null, so exposing it is an obvious small feature. A copy built on the pre-fix findTags style would be a second implementation in another module.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89), string-formatted JDBC query in a DAO

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module build (logicaldoc-core, logicaldoc-webapp, logicaldoc-webservice, logicaldoc-util, logicaldoc-gui/GWT). Needs a modern JDK because the code uses String.formatted and instanceof pattern matching; exact version not checked.
O10_build.project_tests: logicaldoc-core/src/test/java/com/logicaldoc/core/document/HibernateDocumentDAOTest.java:564-605 (testFindTags, prefix 'a' only, no null case) and :607-621 (findAllTags with null)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap firstLetter in SqlUtil.doubleQuotes(...) like the neighbouring tag queries (still breakable on MySQL by a backslash), or copy the published Map.of binding, which throws NPE on the null/no-filter path.

out_of_scope_notes: FolderSearch builds string criteria with doubleQuotes only (logicaldoc-core/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/core/searchengine/folder/FolderSearch.java:336-366). Same backslash differential, but a different sink (folder search, not tags).

HibernateFolderHistoryDAO and HibernateFolderDAO name lookups also use doubleQuotes-only LIKE (logicaldoc-core/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/core/folder/HibernateFolderHistoryDAO.java:62, logicaldoc-core/src/main/java/com/logicaldoc/core/folder/HibernateFolderDAO.java:625-627). Not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb: size not measured (no shell used).

The O8 routes depend on the MySQL/MariaDB default of backslash escaping in string literals (NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES off). The project tests run on HSQLDB, where doubleQuotes is sufficient, so hidden behavioural tests would need a MySQL-dialect harness or a mock/inspection of the generated SQL.
O13 recall risk is a guess; no write-ups were searched (no network).
j_defence_ineffective=1 refers to the doubleQuotes-only escaping on the O8 routes, not the fix site, which had no defence.
The NPE in the published fix for firstLetter == null is read from fix.diff:19 and was not run.
